snippet.title: Crystalfall Content Update on June 4th | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Our Content Update is coming on June 4th, 2026!

The patch will bring new content, new progression mechanics and QoL improvements in response to key player feedback. 

Play Crystalfall for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574970/Crystalfall/

What’s coming to Patch 1:
- 57 New Uniques
- 7 New Mobs
- 4 New Skills
- Skill Quality Upgrade Mechanic
- Multiple Choice Talent Tree Nodes
- Unique Endgame Map and Boss
- Endgame Anomalies in different rarities
- Endgame Lootable Cargo items in different rarities
- Cargo quest objectives
- QoL: Loot Filter
- QoL: Buy 1 Stash Tab for Shards
- QoL: Experimental early-stage WASD movement-only controls option
- Barebones offline singleplayer mode
- Balancing and performance improvements
- Monetization adjustments

Crystalfall is a free online steampunk ARPG where procedural skills drive combat and progression. Play as surviving mutants in a world destroyed by a mysterious asteroid. 

The Early Access offers 3 classes, 5 acts and early stage endgame with localization in 12 languages.

Voice Actor for Trailer Boss Narrator: Chris Bussey
